body:
Kanban BP-LOBBY-001 was a big, unscoped ask. Real investigation found the actual blocker: apps/lobby/src/main.c's net_send_cmd/net_tick are commented out, so STATE_GAME_NET predicts locally but never really networks players. Wrote BRAWLPIT/docs/BP_LOBBY_MATCHMAKING_NORTHSTAR.md, a real 5-phase plan (netcode -> matchmaking queue -> portal -> sandbox mode -> no-chat non-task). Registered as BP-LOBBY-MATCHMAKING-NORTH golden doc. Sub-tasks returned to EMILY/BACKLOG.md, card moved to backlog per Principle 19 (not marked done on a plan alone). session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
